<p>Where diamond and CBN wheels apply — carbide tools, sapphire, cermet inserts (diamond); HSS, hardened steel, cast parts (CBN). Diamond wheels are suitable for: 1) Tools, rotary bodies, molds and wear parts made of carbide; 2) Sapphire ingots and wafer lapping/polishing; 3) Cermet inserts. CBN wheels are suitable for: 1) HSS and high-alloy steel cutting tools, fixtures and molds; 2) Hardened-steel parts and machine beds; 3) High-hardness, high-alloy castings such as cylinder liners and wear parts.</p>
